attributes.readMe:
## Addendum

Adds terms to an executed contract — new scope, an extra schedule — without touching existing text. Contrast with Amendment (changes terms) and a waiver (excuses one obligation): keeping them distinct IS the domain distinction.

### Non-goals

No signature routing of its own — an addendum travels the contract’s existing review and execution road.
